feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 25 October 2026 12:12pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 25 October 2026 at 12:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Expect sunny intervals today, with a risk of isolated showers until later. Westerly gales, locally severe in exposed spots, will persist into the early afternoon with gusts of 50 to 60 mph bringing a continued risk of minor damage and travel disruption. Winds peaked overnight and continue to slowly decrease, and will drop below gale force this evening before easing significantly tonight. Maximum temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

A band of rain will arrive tomorrow morning, clearing through the afternoon to leave a dry spell before further rain arrives overnight. Following a relatively quiet start, gale force to severe gale force winds will develop later in the day and continue through the night. Maximum temperature 15°C.

Tuesday will be mostly dry and bright with sunny intervals, accompanied by strong to gale force southwesterly winds.
